heroSub: Kalder Precision provides high-accuracy sensor hardware and integrated monitoring software to ensure operational continuity across demanding industrial environments.

products.name: Triaxial Vibration Sensor
products.summary: High-frequency seismic and mechanical vibration monitoring.
products.description: The KV-700 provides continuous three-axis measurement for rotating machinery. It is designed for deployment in high-interference environments. The unit features a ruggedised stainless steel housing.

products.name: Infrared Thermal Sensor
products.summary: Non-contact temperature monitoring for high-voltage components.
products.description: This sensor provides real-time thermal profiling without physical contact. It is ideal for identifying hot spots in electrical switchgear. The internal processing unit compensates for ambient temperature fluctuations.

products.name: Laser Displacement Sensor
products.summary: Sub-micron distance measurement for precision manufacturing.
products.description: The KL-50 uses triangulation technology to measure surface distance. It is suitable for high-speed production lines requiring constant verification. The sensor is resistant to dust and oil mist.

products.name: Multi-Gas Detector
products.summary: Detection of combustible and toxic gas concentrations.
products.description: Engineered for hazardous zones, the KG-9 monitors multiple gas species simultaneously. It provides rapid response times for critical safety protocols. The unit is fully certified for explosive atmospheres.

platform.name: Kalder Sense
platform.heading: Unified condition monitoring software
platform.body: Kalder Sense aggregates data from all Kalder hardware into a single interface. It provides predictive analytics to prevent unplanned downtime.

caseStudy.title: Reducing rolling stock maintenance intervals through vibration analysis
caseStudy.challenge: The client faced rising maintenance costs due to unpredictable component failure. Existing inspection schedules were too frequent and labour-intensive.
caseStudy.result: Implementing Kalder Sense enabled a transition to condition-based maintenance. This reduced unscheduled downtime and optimised spare parts inventory.
